intro: Watching the Roads is a Forsaken quest in Silverpine Forest directed by Shadow Priest Allister of the Sepulcher. It tasks adventurers with striking at Dalaran Wizards and Watchers along the roads near Ambermill to halt Kirin Tor shipments into Forsaken territory.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.

Search the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Every moment we delay another shipment arrives on our doorstep. Put them down, adventurer!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ever since the barrier went down around Dalaran, the Kirin Tor have maintained a death grip on the roads. They're paranoid about something, that much is certain.
For now, however, the why is irrelevant.
